name: Fleeting Dream
source:
The Dragon Emperor has recently taken a male fox spirit as his lover. Qiu Ye is affectionate, considerate and obedient — everything he could ask for in a partner. Yet their domestic bliss is threatened when Qiu Ye becomes plagued by strange nightmares.

[From [url=https://kanekos99.itch.io/fleeting-dream]itch.io[/url]]
